curator_note: AI-curated independent gold. Topic: RAG evaluation benchmarks. Corpus era: 2021-2025. Verified: RGB benchmark (2309.01431), GraphRAG (2404.16130).

topics.review_note: Papers covering RAG faithfulness, context relevance, retrieval evaluation benchmarks. Verified: 2309.01431 (RGB), 2404.16130 (GraphRAG).

paper_relevance.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RGB)
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: RGB benchmark — evaluates LLMs on 4 RAG abilities: noise robustness, negative rejection, information integration, counterfactual robustness. Verified abstract. Directly addresses all 3 themes.

paper_relevance.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: GraphRAG — graph-based RAG addressing global sensemaking queries that standard RAG fails on. Introduces new evaluation dimensions for RAG comprehensiveness. Verified abstract.

paper_relevance.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Original RAG paper — dense passage retrieval combined with seq2seq generation. Foundation of RAG evaluation framework. Faithfulness to retrieved context.

paper_relevance.title: ARES: An Automated Evaluation Framework for RAG Systems
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: ARES — automated RAG evaluation using weak supervision and few-shot LLM judges for context relevance, answer faithfulness, and answer relevance. Directly addresses all themes.

paper_relevance.title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: RAGAS framework — computes faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision, context recall without labeled gold answers. Standard RAG evaluation toolkit.

paper_relevance.title: CRUD-RAG: A Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for RAG
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: CRUD-RAG — benchmark evaluating Create/Read/Update/Delete operations in RAG, covering faithfulness and retrieval quality across diverse query types.

paper_relevance.title: Searching for Best Practices in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Systematic study of RAG pipeline components: query expansion, chunk size, retrieval methods — provides empirical evaluation of retrieval quality factors.

paper_relevance.title: Seven Failure Points When Engineering a Retrieval Augmented Generation System
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Taxonomy of RAG failure modes: missing content, missed top-ranked docs, not in context, wrong format, incorrect specificity, incomplete answers — evaluation-relevant.

paper_relevance.title: A Survey on RAG Meets LLMs: Towards Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Comprehensive survey covering RAG evaluation metrics: faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision/recall. Reviews benchmarks and evaluation frameworks.

paper_relevance.title: HELMET: How to Evaluate Long-Context Language Models Effectively and Thoroughly
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: HELMET — comprehensive evaluation of long-context LLMs in RAG scenarios: faithfulness to retrieved context, multi-doc synthesis, recall of relevant information.

paper_relevance.title: RECALL: A Benchmark for LLMs Robustness against External Counterfactual Knowledge
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: RECALL benchmark — tests LLM faithfulness when retrieved context contradicts parametric knowledge. Directly addresses faithfulness in RAG evaluation.

paper_relevance.title: Adaptive-RAG: Learning to Adapt Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Adaptive-RAG — classifier decides single-step vs multi-step retrieval per query. Evaluation framework for context relevance and retrieval efficiency.

paper_relevance.title: FActScoring: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long-Form Text Generation
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: FActScore — atomic factual precision evaluation for RAG outputs. Decomposes generated text into atomic claims and verifies each against retrieved evidence.

paper_relevance.title: VERA: Validation and Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Networks
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: VERA — comprehensive RAG validation framework covering retrieval quality, context grounding, and faithfulness with automated scoring.

paper_relevance.title: RAG vs Fine-tuning: Pipelines, Tradeoffs, and a Case Study on Agriculture
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Comparative evaluation of RAG vs fine-tuning — faithfulness, context relevance, and accuracy tradeoffs. Provides benchmark methodology for RAG evaluation.

topics.reference_answer: RAG evaluation benchmarks assess three core capabilities: (1) Faithfulness: whether generated answers are grounded in retrieved context (RAGAS faithfulness metric; RGB counterfactual robustness test); hallucination when context contradicts LLM priors is a key failure mode. (2) Context relevance: whether retrieved documents contain the information needed to answer (ARES context relevance score; retrieval precision/recall); GraphRAG addresses global queries where standard top-k retrieval fails. (3) Retrieval evaluation: RGB noise robustness and negative rejection tests; CRUD-RAG covers diverse query types; systematic studies (Barnett et al.) enumerate 7 failure points. Emerging challenge: evaluating RAG on long-context multi-document synthesis (HELMET benchmark). No single benchmark covers all dimensions; RAGAS + RGB together are the most widely adopted.
